data.title: About Jeffrey
bio: Jeff started his real estate career with a mission to help people with the biggest and most important purchase of their lives.  More than two decades later, he's still successful - Just ask one of the many people who found their dream home with his help.

Jeff's professional, educational and personal backgrounds create a unique blend rarely found in the industry.  With experience in the Advertising and Marketing field, a Bachelor's degree in Finance and Economics and being a life-long resident of Middlesex County, he is well-positioned to offer great service and insight in a challenging market.

Working his way up on his own, and now being Broker/Owner of Green Light Realty, he has proven to be a hard-working Central Jersey real estate agent and has earned the trust and business of many home buyers and sellers.  He provides clients with the information needed to make smart decisions in this ever-changing market, offering patience, guidance and attention to detail that is valued as much by first-time buyers and sellers as it is by seasoned professional investors.
